authorization.userRequest: 推荐榜和必装榜都要包含 DSH Store 与 DSH 插件开发，并随机放在前10名内
authorization.scope: Update ranking generation/display copy and disposable-fixture tests only; submit through a CI-checked PR. No Catalog/admission mutation, author outreach, Profile/package changes, or production deployment.
authorization.placementPolicy: Place the two exact official repository identities at two distinct pseudo-random positions within ranks 1-10, seeded by the weekly snapshot timestamp and chart type. This keeps positions stable for repeated site builds and changes them only with a weekly snapshot refresh.

constraints: Match only the exact canonical GitHub repositories AI-Scarlett/DSH-Store and AI-Scarlett/build-dsh-plugin; no fuzzy name matching.
Both official entries must appear once in Recommended and Must-have whenever their ranking snapshot records are not blocked or rejected; assign distinct ranks within the first ten.
Use deterministic pseudo-random placement seeded by weeklyStarsObservedAt and chart type so three-hour rebuilds do not cause rank flicker; change placement only after weekly snapshot refresh.
Label official placements transparently; never claim they were selected by GitHub star count, editorial review, category leadership, or security assessment unless that evidence independently applies.
Preserve Catalog listing status and unlisted reasons; this ranking exception never changes admission, installability, repository pinning, or plugin lifecycle behavior.
Preserve existing 30-row caps, pagination, other entries' relative ordering, blocked/rejected exclusions, bilingual interface, and no-install-control behavior.
Tests use disposable in-memory fixtures only; no writes to ~/.dsh, real profiles, Catalog, or production sites.
gates: verify current base Commit and all file-scope SHA-256 preconditions

focused ranking tests: exact repo matching, two unique top-10 positions, snapshot stability/weekly rotation, labels, listing-state preservation, blocked/rejected exclusion, row caps and no install/admission changes
create an auditable PR with the connected short-lived GitHub App authorization; require exact-head CI before merge
production deployment is not authorized by this plan; wait for a separate explicit launch request

rollback.method: Revert only this PR through a new CI-checked PR, or restore the scoped source files from baseCommit.
rollback.production: No production mutation occurs in this plan; existing ranking snapshot and storefront releases remain untouched.

verification.scopeReview: Only the two ranking runtime files, their focused fixture tests, and this plan are changed.

currentCatalogBoundary.buildDshPlugin: unlisted; current compatibility hold and review reason preserved
